name: aleph-zero
description: Local code search for coding agents: ranked code locations by meaning or by name, always matching the working tree, and steering that makes Claude Code use it before recursive grep

rung.title: Steering rung
rung.description: How much the plugin steers Claude Code towards Aleph. 0: the search tools only. 1: tools loaded up front with tuned descriptions and a short standing instruction. 2: also ranked locations with the first prompt of a session. 3: also ranked locations after a recursive grep that found nothing.
